pages.text: The $(item)Weeping Fountain$() weeps the things I cannot find down here, paid in essence.

pages.name: Weeping Fountain
pages.text: 5 by 5 floor, a basin wall one high round it.

pages.title: What It Weeps
pages.text: I tell it what to weep, and it weeps them one at a time, paying from its own store first, then from the sources near it, then from an altar within 24.$(br2)Amethyst, crying obsidian and echo shards first. Ghast tears and pearls at its second tier. Catalysts and wither skulls at its third.

pages.title: Speed
pages.text: Its second tier weeps three times as fast as the first. Its third weeps thirty times as fast.$(br2)I sat by it for an hour once, only to hear water again.
